items: 一個目盲的生物無法看見，且在任何需要視覺的屬性檢定中自動失敗。
對目盲生物進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢，且目盲生物的攻擊檢定具有劣勢。

condition.name: Blinded
entries: 當你處於目盲狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Can't See
entries: 你無法看見，且在任何需要視覺的屬性檢定中自動失敗。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: {@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}檢定對你具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}，而你的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

items: 一個被魅惑的生物不能攻擊魅惑者、或以魅惑者作為有害能力或魔法效果的目標。
魅惑者在對被魅惑的生物社交互動時所進行的所有屬性檢定具有優勢。

condition.name: Charmed
entries: 當你處於魅惑狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Can't Harm the Charmer
entries: 你無法攻擊魅惑者，也無法以具傷害性的能力或{@variantrule Magical Effect|XPHB|魔法效果}將魅惑者作為目標。

entries.name: Social Advantage
entries: 魅惑者在與你進行社交互動的任何屬性檢定上具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

items: 一個耳聾的生物無法聽見聲音，且在任何需要聽力的屬性檢定中自動失敗。

condition.name: Deafened
entries: 當你處於耳聾狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Can't Hear
entries: 你無法聽見，且在任何需要聽覺的屬性檢定中自動失敗。

condition.name: Exhaustion
entries: 某些特殊能力和險酷環境，例如飢餓或長時間處於寒冷或炎熱的溫度下，將會導致一個被稱為力竭的特殊狀態。力竭分成六個等級。根據效果的敘述，一個效果可能會使生物獲得一個或多個力竭等級。

rows: 所有屬性檢定具有劣勢
所有攻擊檢定和豁免檢定具有劣勢

entries: 如果一個已經力竭的生物再次受到會導致力竭的效果影響，它現在的力竭等級將會再加上該效果敘述中所記載的力竭等級。
一個生物會承受他目前力竭等級和以下等級的所有力竭效果。例如：一個力竭等級2的生物會同時承受速度減半以及屬性檢定劣勢的效果。
一個移除力竭狀態的能力會依照該能力的敘述來減少對應程度的力竭等級。當一個生物的力竭等級被減少至低於1，則結束所有的力竭效果。
只要一個生物有進食和飲水，則完成一次長休將可以減少它1級力竭等級。此外，被從死裡復活會使生物的力竭等級減少1級。

condition.name: Exhaustion
entries: 當你處於力竭狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Exhaustion Levels
entries: 此狀態會累積。你每次獲得此狀態，便獲得 1 級力竭。若你的力竭等級達到 6，你便會死亡。

entries.name: D20 Tests Affected
entries: 當你進行 D20 檢定時，擲骰結果減去你力竭等級的 2 倍。

entries.name: Speed Reduced
entries: 你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}減少等於你力竭等級 5 倍的呎數。

entries.name: Removing Exhaustion Levels
entries: 完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}會移除你 1 級力竭。當你的力竭等級降至 0 時，此狀態結束。

items: 當恐懼的來源在視線可及的範圍時，被恐懼的生物在屬性檢定和攻擊檢定上具有劣勢。
生物不能自願地移近它恐懼的來源。

condition.name: Frightened
entries: 當你處於恐懼狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Ability Checks and Attacks Affected
entries: 當恐懼的來源在你的視線範圍內時，你在屬性檢定與攻擊檢定上具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。
entries.name_zh: 屬性檢定與攻擊受影響

entries.name: Can't Approach
entries: 你無法自願移動得更接近恐懼的來源。

items: 一個被擒生物的移動速度歸0，且不能受益於任何對它移動速度的加值。
如果擒抱者陷入{@condition Incapacitated||無力}，被擒狀態將就此結束。
如果被擒生物被移出擒抱者或是其他造成擒抱效果的來源的觸及範圍，被擒狀態將就此結束。像是被{@spell Thunderwave|phb|雷鳴波}給擊飛。

condition.name: Grappled
entries: 當你處於被擒狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Speed 0
entries: 你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}為 0 且無法增加。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: 你對擒抱者以外任何目標的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

entries.name: Movable
entries: 擒抱者移動時可以拖拽或攜帶你，但除非你是微型或比它小兩個或更多體型，否則它每移動 1 呎都要額外花費 1 呎。

items: 一個無力的生物不能採取任何動作或反應。

condition.name: Incapacitated
entries: 當你處於無力狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Inactive
entries: 你無法採取任何{@variantrule Action|XPHB|動作}、{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}或{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}。

entries.name: No Concentration
entries: 你的{@status Concentration|XPHB|專注}被打斷。

entries.name: Speechless
entries: 你無法說話。

entries.name: Surprised
entries: 若你在擲{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}時處於無力狀態，你在該擲骰上具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

items: 若是沒有魔法或特殊感官的幫助，是不可能看見一個隱形生物的。在要進行躲藏時，該生物被視作重度遮蔽。該生物的所在位置可以透過任何它發出的噪音或留下的蹤跡被偵測到。
對隱形生物進行的攻擊檢定具有劣勢，且隱形生物的攻擊檢定具有優勢。

condition.name: Invisible
entries: 當你處於隱形狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Surprise
entries: 若你在擲{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}時處於隱形狀態，你在該擲骰上具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Concealed
entries: 除非效果的創造者能以某種方式看見你，否則你不受任何要求其目標可被看見的效果影響。你穿戴或攜帶的任何裝備也會被隱藏。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: {@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}檢定對你具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}，而你的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。若某個生物能以某種方式看見你，你對該生物便無法獲得此好處。

items: 麻痺的生物處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態，且無法移動或說話。
該生物在力量與敏捷豁免檢定上自動失敗。
對該生物的攻擊檢定具有優勢。
若攻擊者位於該生物 5 呎內，任何命中該生物的攻擊都是重擊。

condition.name: Paralyzed
entries: 當你處於麻痺狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Incapacitated
entries: 你處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}狀態。

entries.name: Speed 0
entries: 你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}為 0 且無法增加。

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: 你在力量與敏捷{@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|豁免檢定}上自動失敗。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: {@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}檢定對你具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Automatic Critical Hits
entries: 若攻擊者位於你 5 呎內，任何命中你的攻擊檢定都是{@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB|重擊}。

items: 一個被石化的生物和它身上穿戴或攜帶的任何非魔法物品都會一起被變形成無生命的固體材質（通常是石頭）。它的重量將增加至十倍，並且停止老化。
該生物陷入{@condition Incapacitated||無力}，不能移動或說話、且無法感知其周遭的環境。
對該生物進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢。
該生物的力量和敏捷豁免自動失敗。
該生物對所有的傷害具有抗力。
該生物免疫毒素和疾病，已存在於該生物體內的毒素或疾病將會停止運作，而非被解除。

condition.name: Petrified
entries: 當你處於石化狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Turned to Inanimate Substance
entries: 你連同你穿戴與攜帶的任何非魔法物體，一起被轉化為固態的無生命物質（通常是石頭）。你的重量增加為原本的十倍，且你停止老化。

entries.name: Incapacitated
entries: 你處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}狀態。

entries.name: Speed 0
entries: 你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}為 0 且無法增加。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: {@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}檢定對你具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: 你在力量與敏捷{@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|豁免檢定}上自動失敗。

entries.name: Resist Damage
entries: 你對所有傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。

entries.name: Poison Immunity
entries: 你對{@condition Poisoned|XPHB|中毒}狀態具有{@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|免疫}。

items: 一個中毒的生物在攻擊檢定與屬性檢定上具有劣勢。

condition.name: Poisoned
entries: 當你處於中毒狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Ability Checks and Attacks Affected
entries: 你在攻擊檢定與屬性檢定上具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。
entries.name_zh: 屬性檢定與攻擊受影響

items: 一個伏地的生物唯一的移動方式是爬行，除非它站起來以結束此狀態。
該生物在攻擊檢定上具有劣勢。
如果攻擊者距離該生物5呎以內，則對該生物進行的攻擊檢定將具有優勢。除此之外，對該生物的攻擊檢定具有劣勢。

condition.name: Prone
entries: 當你處於伏地狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Restricted Movement
entries: 你唯一的移動選項是{@variantrule Crawling|XPHB|爬行}，或花費等於你{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}一半（無條件捨去）的移動力起身，從而結束此狀態。若你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}為 0，你便無法起身。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: 你的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。若攻擊者位於你 5 呎內，對你的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}；否則該攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

items: 一個被束縛生物的移動速度歸0，且不能受益於任何對它移動速度的加值。
對該生物進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢，且該生物的攻擊檢定具有劣勢。
該生物在敏捷豁免上具有劣勢。

condition.name: Restrained
entries: 當你處於束縛狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Speed 0
entries: 你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}為 0 且無法增加。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: {@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}檢定對你具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}，而你的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: 你在敏捷{@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|豁免檢定}上具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

items: 一個被震懾的生物處於{@condition Incapacitated||無力}，不能移動．且只能有氣無力地說話。
該生物的力量和敏捷豁免自動失敗。
對該生物進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢。

condition.name: Stunned
entries: 當你處於震懾狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Incapacitated
entries: 你處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}狀態。

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: 你在力量與敏捷{@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|豁免檢定}上自動失敗。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: {@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}檢定對你具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

items: 一個昏迷的生物處於{@condition Incapacitated||無力}，不能移動或說話．且無法感知其周遭的環境。
該生物持握的所有東西都會脫手，並且陷入{@condition Prone||伏地}狀態。
該生物的力量和敏捷豁免自動失敗。
對該生物進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢。
若攻擊者距離該生物5呎以內，則任何其命中該生物的攻擊都視為重擊。

condition.name: Unconscious
entries: 當你處於昏迷狀態時，你會受到以下效果。

entries.name: Inert
entries: 你處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}與{@condition Prone|XPHB|伏地}狀態，並掉落你手中持有的任何東西。此狀態結束時，你仍處於{@condition Prone|XPHB|伏地}狀態。

entries.name: Speed 0
entries: 你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}為 0 且無法增加。

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: {@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}檢定對你具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: 你在力量與敏捷{@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|豁免檢定}上自動失敗。

entries.name: Automatic Critical Hits
entries: 若攻擊者位於你 5 呎內，任何命中你的攻擊檢定都是{@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB|重擊}。

entries.name: Unaware
entries: 你對周遭環境毫無察覺。

disease.name: Arcane Blight
entries: Any humanoid that spends 12 hours in the necropolis must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or contract an arcane blight. This magical disease transforms the humanoid into a {@creature nothic}, but only after the victim experiences hallucinations and feelings of isolation and paranoia. Other symptoms include clammy skin, hair loss, and myopia (nearsightedness).

A player character infected with the arcane blight gains the following flaw: "I don't trust anyone." This flaw, which supersedes any conflicting flaw, is fed by delusions that are difficult for the character to distinguish from reality. Common delusions include the belief that that allies are conspiring to steal the victim's riches or otherwise turn against the victim.

Whenever it finishes a long rest, an infected humanoid must repeat the saving throw. On a successful save, the DC for future saves against the arcane blight drops by {@dice 1d6}. If the saving throw DC drops to 0, the creature overcomes the arcane blight and becomes immune to the effect of further exposure. A creature that fails three of these saving throws transforms into a {@creature nothic} under the DM's control. Only a {@spell wish} spell or divine intervention can undo this transformation.
A {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic ends the infection on the target, removing the flaw and all other symptoms, but this magic doesn't protect the target against further exposure.

disease.name: Blinding Sickness
entries: Pain grips the creature's mind, and its eyes turn milky white. The creature has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws and is {@condition blinded}.
{@note This disease can be inflicted with the {@spell contagion|PHB} spell.}

disease.name: Blue Mist Fever
entries: A magical mist creeps through the jungles of Chult. Contact with this thin, blue, odorless mist can infect giants and humanoids with blue mist fever. A {@spell dispel magic} spell destroys the mist in a 20-foot square starting at a point chosen by the caster within the spell's range. An encounter with this mist typically covers {@dice 1d6} such areas (400-2,400 square feet).

A giant or humanoid that comes into contact with the mist must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become infected with blue mist fever. An infected creature begins seeing vivid hallucinations of blue monkeys {@dice 1d6} hours after failing the save, and the hallucinations last until the disease ends on the creature. A creature can repeat the saving throw every 24 hours, ending the effect on itself on a success.

disease.name: Bluerot
entries: This disease targets humanoids. While afflicted with bluerot, a victim grows grotesque blue boils on their face and back. This disease is carried by undead (including the drowned ones in Tammeraut's Fate), and victims most often acquire it through wounds caused by infected creatures. The disease's boils manifest in {@dice 1d4} hours, causing the victim's Constitution and Charisma scores to decrease by {@dice 1d4} each, to a minimum of 3. This is quickly followed by a fever and tingling in the extremities. An infected creature is vulnerable to radiant damage and gains the ability to breathe underwater.

At the end of each long rest, an infected creature makes a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a success, the victim regains 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Charisma lost to the disease. If the infected creature regains all the points lost to the disease, it is cured. Other effects that raise the victim's ability scores do not cure the disease. On a failed saving throw, the victim takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage as the boils burst and spread. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage cannot regain hit points until the disease is cured, though it can be stabilized as normal.

disease.name: Cackle Fever
entries: 這個疾病以類人生物為感染對象，然而奇怪的是地侏免疫這個疾病。在這個疾病的影響下，患者會經常地陷入瘋狂的大笑中，這也讓這個疾病得到了它通俗且病態的名稱："鬼嚎症"。
這個疾病的症狀會在受感染後{@dice 1d4}小時後發作，包括了發燒與方向感錯亂。受感染的生物獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，且在疾病被治癒前不能被移除。
任何將導致被感染的生物陷入極大壓力的事件，包括進入戰鬥、受到傷害、經歷恐懼、或做惡夢等，都會迫使該生物進行一次DC13的體質豁免。

若豁免失敗，該生物受到5({@dice 1d10})精神傷害，且在瘋狂大笑中陷入{@condition Incapacitated||無力}狀態長達1分鐘。該生物可以在它的每個回合結束時重複這個豁免檢定，若成功則停止瘋狂大笑並解除{@condition Incapacitated||無力}狀態。任何在受感染生物的痛苦瘋笑10呎之內開始它回合的類人生物，都必須成功通過一次DC10的體質豁免否則也將被這個疾病感染。一旦一個生物成功通過這個豁免，它在24小時以內將免疫來自特定感染生物的瘋笑的影響。

At the end of each long rest, an infected creature can make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the DC for this save and for the save to avoid an attack of mad laughter drops by {@dice 1d6}. When the saving throw DC drops to 0, the creature recovers from the disease. A creature that fails three of these saving throws gains a randomly determined form of {@variantrule Madness|DMG|indefinite madness}.

disease.name: Cackle Fever
entries: Cheaply made potions and elixirs are sometimes tainted by Cackle Fever, which affects Humanoids only (gnomes are strangely immune). A creature suffers the following effects {@dice 1d4} days after infection:

items.name: Fever
items.entry: The creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level, which lasts until the contagion ends on the creature.

items.name: Uncontrollable Laughter
items.entry: While the creature has the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} condition, the creature makes a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw each time it takes damage other than Psychic damage. On a failed save, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition as it laughs uncontrollably. At the end of each of its turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

entries.name: Fighting the Contagion
entries: At the end of each Long Rest, an infected creature makes a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. After the creature succeeds on three of these saves, the contagion ends on it, and the creature is immune to Cackle Fever for 1 year.

entries.name: Spreading the Contagion
entries: Any Humanoid (other than a gnome) that starts its turn within a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from a creature infected with Cackle Fever must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or also become infected with the contagion. On a successful save, the Humanoid can't catch the contagion from that particular infected creature for the next 24 hours.

disease.name: Filth Fever
entries: A raging fever sweeps through the creature's body. The creature has disadvantage on Strength checks, Strength saving throws, and attack rolls that use Strength.
{@note This disease can be inflicted with the {@spell contagion|PHB} spell.}

disease.name: Flesh Rot
entries: The creature's flesh decays. The creature has disadvantage on Charisma checks and vulnerability to all damage.
{@note This disease can be inflicted with the {@spell contagion|PHB} spell.}

disease.name: Frigid Woe
entries: Frigid woe is a special disease developed by Aeor's mages that cannot be cured by conventional treatment or magic. The only way a creature infected with the disease can be cured is by finding and drinking the manufactured antidote, a milky liquid stored in gold vials found in Eiselcross's ruins. This disease was created to slow down the forces of the gods and get around the healing power of their clerics and angels.

The disease is transmitted by breathing in blue spores that Aeor's mages created long ago. When a creature comes into contact with these spores, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected with frigid woe. It takes {@dice 1d4} days for the symptoms to manifest in an infected creature. These symptoms include fatigue, chills, and visible blue veins that appear on the creature's body. The infected creature's speed is reduced by 5 feet as long as it remains infected. Every 10 days after symptoms appear, an infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, or its speed is reduced by another 5 feet. If a creature's speed is reduced to 0 as a result of this disease, the creature dies and its body turns into a statue made of ice.
A creature can drink the antidote as an action, ending all symptoms and effects of the disease instantly.

disease.name: Ghoul Gut
entries: Water polluted with ghoul parts carries ghoul gut. A creature drinking this tainted water must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or contract the disease. Symptoms strike when a victim starts a long rest or next becomes excited, as during combat. A victim suffers severe cramps, and their bowels make sounds like two ghouls fighting. When the symptoms first strike, the victim takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) necrotic damage. In addition, a diseased victim regains no hit points or Hit Dice from nonmagical sources, including resting or spending Hit Dice. A victim who finishes a long rest can attempt a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the victim shakes off the disease. Failure deals the character another 5 ({@damage 2d4}) necrotic damage.

A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check can also remove the disease from another creature. Doing so requires the character making the check to care for the sick individual during a long rest. The caregiver gains no benefit from that rest.

disease.name: Grackle-Lung
entries: The constant smog in Gracklstugh causes grackle-lung in living, breathing creatures, resulting in persistent, wracking coughs and the spewing of thick, black phlegm. Whenever a living, breathing creature finishes a long rest in Gracklstugh, it must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On each failed save, the creature gains one level of {@condition exhaustion} as its airways become increasingly clogged. A creature that reaches level 6 {@condition exhaustion} dies, as normal.

A creature with one or more levels of {@condition exhaustion} brought on by grackle-lung must succeed on a Constitution check to take the {@action Dash} action. If the check fails, the action cannot be attempted. If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a verbal component, it must succeed on a Constitution check or be unable to complete the spell, causing the spell to fail with no effect. The DC for each check is 10 + the creature's current {@condition exhaustion} level.

If a creature's {@condition exhaustion} level drops below 1, it no longer suffers the effects of grackle-lung and becomes immune to it for the next week. Duergar and derro are inured to grackle-lung, making Constitution checks against it with advantage. Any spell or effect that cures disease also cures grackle-lung, effectively removing all levels of {@condition exhaustion} brought on by the affliction.

disease.name: Lichen Plague
entries: A Beast, Giant, Humanoid, or Monstrosity that comes into contact with bile lichen spores is at risk of contracting a horrible disease as the lichen takes root on its body and grows into its brain. A creature suffers the following effects {@dice 1d4} days after infection:

items.name: Skinroot
items.entry: The contagion first appears as a patch of green-yellow lichen no larger than 1 square inch on a random area of the body. When it finishes a Long Rest, the infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 Exhaustion level as the lichen spreads toward the creature's head. This Exhaustion level lasts until the contagion ends on the creature.

items.name: Mindroot
items.entry: A Humanoid that dies while infected with Lichen Plague rises immediately as a {@creature Zombie|XMM} under the DM's control.

entries.name: Fighting the Contagion
entries: When it finishes a Long Rest, an infected creature makes a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. If the creature succeeds on three of these saving throws, the contagion ends on the creature and the creature is immune to Lichen Plague forever. The successful saves don't need to be consecutive.

entries.name: Spreading the Contagion
entries: Any Beast, Giant, Humanoid, or Monstrosity that makes skin contact with the lichen on an infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Lichen Plague. On a successful save, the creature can't catch Lichen Plague for the next 24 hours.

disease.name: Mindfire
entries: The creature's mind becomes feverish. The creature has disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saving throws, and the creature behaves as if under the effects of the {@spell confusion} spell during combat.
{@note This disease can be inflicted with the {@spell contagion|PHB} spell.}

disease.name: Mudpox
entries: Contact with dead oozes from the Underdark mixed with snowmelt and mud has been making people sick. Any Beast or Humanoid that touches mud contaminated by Mudpox must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or become infected, suffering the following effect:

items.name: Disrupted Digestion
items.entry: Daily at dawn, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or vomit up the food it ate the previous day, gaining 1 Exhaustion level. If the creature succeeds on this saving throw three consecutive times, the contagion ends.

entries.name: Fighting the Contagion
entries: A {@spell Heal|XPHB} or {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell ends the contagion immediately.

entries.name: Spreading the Contagion
entries: Any Humanoid that makes skin contact with a creature infected with Mudpox must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or also become infected with the contagion. If the creature succeeds on this save, it can't catch the contagion from that particular infected creature for the next 24 hours.

disease.name: Redface
entries: The effects of redface are identical to those of {@disease sight rot} (see "{@book Diseases|DMG|8|Diseases}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}), but it's caused by pollutants in the air rather than contaminated drinking water, making it difficult to avoid.

disease.name: Saprophytic Plague
entries: Xanthoria's research into lichdom and her creation of a living phylactery led to the emergence of the plague spreading across the Sword Coast. Any beast or humanoid that comes within 10 feet of a creature infected by the saprophytic plague must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or become infected as well. On a successful save, a creature is immune to the plague for 24 hours, and any creature that is immune to disease succeeds on the save automatically.

After a failed save, a creature experiences the first symptoms—body aches, nausea, slurred speech, and uncontrollable drooling—{@dice 1d4} hours later and gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. Every 24 hours thereafter, the creature automatically gains another level of {@condition exhaustion}. Any creature killed by the saprophytic plague transforms into a lifeless magenta ooze.

A creature infected by the saprophytic plague for at least 24 hours behaves like a zombie and seems barely aware of its surroundings, as fungal growths sprout from its head, body, and limbs. It feels an overriding urge to be around groups of uninfected creatures so that it can spread the contagion. This is the time when infected humanoids begin speaking the word "Xanthoria" over and over, with no understanding of what the word means. This behavior is the result of a mycelial network of spores that forms a tenuous connection between Xanthoria and humanoids that become infected by the plague.

Foodstuffs that are exposed to the plague's spores decay or go sour within {@dice 2d12} hours, leaving behind a lurid magenta mass of oozing fungi. Eating infected food requires a saving throw as above.
Any magic that cures a disease can rid a creature of the saprophytic plague. Casting {@spell purify food and drink} destroys the infection in foodstuffs.

disease.name: Seizure
entries: The creature is overcome with shaking. The creature has disadvantage on Dexterity checks, Dexterity saving throws, and attack rolls that use Dexterity.
{@note This disease can be inflicted with the {@spell contagion|PHB} spell.}

disease.name: Sewer Plague
entries: 下水道瘟疫是個統稱，用以稱呼各種於下水道、垃圾堆、和汙濁沼澤中滋生的疾病，有時這些疾病會透過生存在該區域的生物傳播，例如老鼠和食腐怪。
當一個類人生物被帶有這個疾病的生物咬傷、或當接觸到帶源生物的穢物或內臟時，該類人生物必須成功通過一次DC11的體質豁免，否則將被感染。
下水道瘟疫的症狀需要{@dice 1d4}天之後才會在受感染的生物身上浮現。症狀包括疲憊與痙攣。受感染的生物獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，在使用生命骰回復時只能回復原本一半的生命值，且完成長休並不會回復任何生命值。
在每次長休結束時，受感染的生物必須進行一次DC11的體質豁免。若豁免失敗，則該生物獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。
若豁免成功，該角色的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級減少一級。如果這個豁免將一個受感染生物的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級減少至低於1，則該生物將從這個疾病中痊癒。

disease.name: Sewer Plague
entries: Fouled potions and alchemical waste can give rise to Sewer Plague, which incubates in sewers and refuse heaps and is sometimes transmitted by creatures that dwell in such areas, including otyughs and rats. Any Humanoid that is wounded by a creature that carries the contagion or that comes into contact with contaminated filth or offal must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected with Sewer Plague. A creature suffers the following effects {@dice 1d4} days after infection:

items.name: Weakness
items.entry: While the creature has any Exhaustion levels, it regains only half the normal number of Hit Points from spending Hit Point Dice.

items.name: Restlessness
items.entry: While the creature has any Exhaustion levels, finishing a Long Rest neither restores lost Hit Points nor reduces the creature's Exhaustion level.

entries.name: Fighting the Contagion
entries: Daily at dawn, an infected creature makes a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level as its fatigue worsens. On a successful save, the creature's Exhaustion level decreases by 1. If the creature's Exhaustion level is reduced to 0, the contagion ends on the creature.

disease.name: Shaking Plague
entries: Magical experiments gone awry gave rise to Shaking Plague, which affects Humanoids. A creature suffers the following effects {@dice 1d4} days after infection:

items.name: Fatigue
items.entry: The creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. While the creature has any {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels, finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} doesn't reduce the creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

items.name: Pus Boils
items.entry: While the creature has any {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels, its skin is covered in pus-filled boils.

items.name: Shaking
items.entry: While the creature has any {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels, magic-dampening tremors afflict it. The creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks and saving throws, and whenever the creature casts a spell with a Somatic component, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, or the spell dissipates with no effect and the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, that slot isn't expended.

entries.name: Fighting the Contagion
entries: Daily at dawn, an infected creature makes a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level as its fatigue worsens. On a successful save, the creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level decreases by 1. If the creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level is reduced to 0, the contagion ends on the creature.

entries.name: Spreading the Contagion
entries: Any Humanoid that makes skin contact with a creature infected with Shaking Plague must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or also become infected with the contagion. On a successful save, the Humanoid can't catch the contagion from that particular infected creature for the next 24 hours.

disease.name: Shivering Sickness
entries: 原生於朱特(Chult)叢林和濕地的昆蟲都帶有震顫之疾這個疾病。最簡單的保護措施是在所有外露的肌膚上塗抹驅蟲劑。（驅蟲劑的價錢，請參照{@adventure "購買特殊物品"|ToA|1|Buying a Special Item}）

一個巨人或類人生物若受到來自{@creature Swarm of Insects|mm|昆蟲群}、{@creature Giant Centipede|mm|巨蜈蚣}、{@creature Giant Scorpion|mm|巨蠍}、或{@creature Giant Wasp|mm|巨黃蜂}的傷害，將在遭遇結束時暴露於這個疾病之下。那些從他們前一次長休到現在都沒有使用驅蟲劑的人，會在完成一次長休之後暴露於這個疾病之下。
一個暴露於這個疾病的巨人或類人生物必須成功通過一次DC11的體質豁免，否則將被感染。擁有天生護甲的生物在這個豁免中具有優勢。症狀需要{@dice 2d6}小時之後才會在受感染的生物身上浮現。症狀包括視力模糊、方向感錯亂、和突然失溫所導致無法控制的牙齒顫抖。
一旦症狀浮現，受感染的生物在使用生命骰回復時只能回復原本一半的生命值，且完成長休並不會回復任何生命值。受感染的生物同時在屬性檢定和攻擊檢定中具有劣勢。在長休結束時，受感染的生物重複該豁免，若豁免成功則從這個疾病中痊癒。

disease.name: Sight Rot
entries: 這個痛苦的傳染病會使血液從眼睛流出，並最終導致患者失明。

飲用被這個疾病汙染的水的野獸或類人生物必須成功通過一次DC15的體質豁免，否則被感染。在被感染後經過一天，該生物的視力將開始變得模糊。該生物在依賴視覺的攻擊檢定和屬性檢定承受-1減值。在症狀浮現後的每個長休結束，這個減值都會惡化1點。當減值達到-5時，患者陷入{@condition Blinded||目盲}直到他的視力被魔法回復，像是{@spell Lesser Restoration||次級復原術}或{@spell heal||治癒術}。
視力腐化可以透過一種生長在沼澤，名為小米草(Eyebright)的罕見花朵給治癒。一個熟練於{@item Herbalism Kit|phb|藥草師工具組}的角色可以用一個小時將花朵製作成一劑軟膏。在長休前塗抹一劑於眼睛上可以防止疾病的惡化，塗抹三劑之後，軟膏將完全治癒疾病。

disease.name: Sight Rot
entries: Any Beast or Humanoid that drinks water tainted by Sight Rot must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the contagion ends.

entries.name: Fighting the Contagion
entries: Magic such as a {@spell Heal|XPHB} or {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell ends the contagion immediately. A character who is proficient with an {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB} can use it to create one dose of nonmagical ointment, which takes 1 hour. When applied to the eyes of a creature suffering from Sight Rot, the ointment suppresses the contagion on that creature for 24 hours. If the contagion is suppressed in this way for a total of 72 hours (requiring three doses and applications of the ointment), the contagion ends on the creature.

entries.name: Spreading the Contagion
entries: Any Humanoid that makes skin contact with a creature infected with Sight Rot must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or also become infected with the contagion. On a successful save, the Humanoid can't catch the contagion from that particular infected creature for the next 24 hours.

disease.name: Slimy Doom
entries: The creature begins to bleed uncontrollably. The creature has disadvantage on Constitution checks and Constitution saving throws. In addition, whenever the creature takes damage, it is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.
{@note This disease can be inflicted with the {@spell contagion|PHB} spell.}

disease.name: Spider Eggs
entries: If the party is defeated, stabilized characters awaken after {@dice 1d4} hours to find themselves cocooned in sticky webs and suspended 10 feet off the floor, with spider eggs implanted in their bodies. A cocooned character is {@condition restrained} and can use its action to try to escape by making a successful {@dc 15} Strength check.

Spider eggs implanted in a host hatch in {@dice 2d12} hours, killing the host as the baby spiders chew their way out. This infestation functions like a disease. A {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic cast upon the host kills the spider eggs, ending the threat.

disease.name: Super-Tetanus
entries: A creature that contracts the disease of super-tetanus is wracked with pain as its heart races and its muscles spasm hard enough to break its bones. The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) damage at the start of each of its turns. If a victim is not cured by other means, it can repeat the saving throw at the end of every minute after becoming exposed, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

disease.name: The Gnawing Plague
entries: The Gnawing Plague, also known as "the Gnaws," is known in every corner of Richemulot.

entries.name: Transmission
entries: The Gnaws is spread when a creature is bitten by a {@creature rat}, {@creature giant rat}, {@creature swarm of rats}, or {@creature wererat} that carries the disease, or by coming into physical contact with an infected creature.

entries.name: Infection
entries: Creatures exposed to the disease must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or become infected. The DC of this saving throw can increase depending on the severity of the plague's spread (see "{@book Cycle of the Plague|VRGR|3|Cycle of the Plague}" below).

entries.name: Symptoms
entries: It takes {@dice 1d2} days for the Gnawing Plague's symptoms to manifest in an infected creature. The infected creature then gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}, regains only half the normal number of hit points from spending Hit Dice, and regains no hit points from finishing a long rest.

The plague's symptoms include buboes, fatigue, splotchy rashes, sweats, and shaking, particularly facial tremors. Locals liken these twitches to the sniffing of rats. Sufferers often have scraps of leather placed in their mouths to prevent their teeth from clattering, though they inevitably gnaw through these scraps.

entries.name: Recovery
entries: At the end of each long rest, an infected creature must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a successful save, the creature's {@condition exhaustion} level decreases by 1. If a successful saving throw reduces the infected creature's level of {@condition exhaustion} below 1, the creature recovers from the disease.

entries.name: Immunity
entries: All forms of rats and wererats are immune to the Gnawing Plague.

disease.name: The Rusting
entries: The Rusting manifests as a thin, iron coating that grows over a victim's body. When exposed to moisture, this iron skin corrodes into a rust-colored plaque. As the Rusting covers the victim, the victim eventually transforms into a type of creature known as a Rusted (see {@book chapter 9|FRAiF|9}).

Any creature that is wounded by a Rusted creature or spends 1 hour in an area where the Rusting has manifested makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on this save. On a failed save, the creature is afflicted by the Rusting and suffers the following effects:

items.name: Curse
items.entry: The creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level and is cursed. While the creature is cursed, finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} doesn't reduce the creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

items.name: Plated Joints
items.entry: The creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 5 feet.

items.name: Rusted Fate
items.entry: When a cursed creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level reaches 6, it doesn't die. Instead, the creature transforms into a Rusted version of its former self; its creature type becomes Construct, and it gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, {@condition Petrified|XPHB}, and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions. The curse then ends for that creature.

entries.name: Fighting the Contagion
entries: Daily at dawn, an afflicted creature makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level as more iron coats its skin. On a successful save, the creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level decreases by 1. If the creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level is reduced to 0, the contagion ends on the creature.
Removing the curse immediately ends the contagion for a creature.

disease.name: Throat Leeches
entries: 這種被稱為咽喉水蛭的微小寄生蟲汙染著整片朱特(Chult)森林、沼澤與河流中的水源。任何飲用受汙染水源的巨人與類人生物必須成功通過一次DC12的體質豁免，否則被咽喉水蛭給寄生。即發性症狀包括喉嚨發炎和呼吸急促。在{@dice 1d6}小時過後，受感染的角色獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，且在疾病被治癒前不能被移除（除非依照以下敘述的方式）。在每次長休結束時，受感染的生物必須重複該豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}；若豁免成功，則該生物減少一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。如果透過成功的豁免檢定將{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等減少至低於1，則該生物將從這個疾病中痊癒。
探險者可以藉由只飲用雨水、煮沸或使用魔法淨化過的水來避免接觸咽喉水蛭。

status.name: Bloodied
entries: 當生物剩餘的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}為其一半或更少時，便處於浴血狀態。

status.name: Concentration
entries: 有些法術需要你維持{@status concentration||專注}，才能讓其魔法保持生效。若你失去{@status concentration||專注}，這類法術便會結束。
若法術必須以{@status concentration||專注}維持，其持續時間項目中會註明這一點，法術也會說明你可以專注於它多久。你可以隨時結束{@status concentration||專注}（不需要動作）。
移動與攻擊之類的一般活動不會干擾{@status concentration||專注}。以下因素可能打斷{@status concentration||專注}：

items.name: Casting another spell that requires concentration
entries: 若你施展另一道需要{@status concentration||專注}的法術，你會失去對原本法術的{@status concentration||專注}。你無法同時專注於兩道法術。
items.name_zh: 施展另一道需要專注的法術
items._zhOf: Casting another spell that requires concentration

items.name: Taking damage
entries: 每當你在{@status concentration||專注}於法術時受到傷害，你必須進行一次體質豁免檢定以維持你的{@status concentration||專注}。DC 等於 10 或你所受傷害的一半，取兩者中較高者。若你受到來自多個來源的傷害，例如一支箭與龍的吐息，你要為每個傷害來源分別進行豁免檢定。

items.name: Being incapacitated or killed
entries: 若你陷入{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態或死亡，你會失去對法術的{@status concentration||專注}。
DM 也可能決定某些環境現象，例如你在風暴肆虐的船上時一道浪打在你身上，需要你成功通過一次 {@dc 10} 體質豁免檢定，才能維持對法術的{@status concentration||專注}。

status.name: Concentration
entries: 有些法術與其他效果需要專注才能保持生效，如其說明所述。若效果的創造者失去專注，效果便會結束。若效果有最長持續時間，效果的說明會註明創造者可以專注於它多久：至多 1 分鐘、1 小時或其他持續時間。創造者可以隨時結束專注（不需要動作）。以下因素會打斷專注。

entries.name: Another Concentration Effect
entries: 當你開始施展一道需要專注的法術，或啟動另一個需要專注的效果時，你會立即失去對原本效果的專注。

entries.name: Damage
entries: 若你受到傷害，你必須成功通過一次體質{@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|豁免檢定}才能維持專注。DC 等於 10 或所受傷害的一半（無條件捨去），取兩者中較高者，最高 DC 為 30。

entries.name: Incapacitated or Dead
entries: 若你處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}狀態或死亡，你的專注便會結束。

status.name: Surprised
entries: 一群冒險者悄悄接近一處盜匪營地，從樹林中躍出攻擊他們。一個{@creature gelatinous cube||凝膠方塊}滑過地城通道，直到吞沒其中一名冒險者，冒險者們才注意到它。在這些情況下，戰鬥的一方對另一方取得突襲。
由 DM 決定誰可能被突襲。若雙方都沒有嘗試隱匿，他們會自動注意到彼此。否則，DM 會將所有躲藏者的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定與對方每個生物的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）值進行比較。任何沒有注意到威脅的角色或怪物，在遭遇開始時處於{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。
若你被突襲，你在戰鬥的第一個回合無法移動或採取動作，且在該回合結束前無法採取反應。即使團體中的其他成員沒有被突襲，團體中的某個成員仍可能處於{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。

status.name: Surprised
entries: 若生物在戰鬥開始時毫無防備，該生物便處於突襲狀態，使它在{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}擲骰上具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。
